title: Kostka cukru — czarna kawa
description: Biała kostka cukru wpada w czarną kawę w kanonicznej szklance Czesława z metalowym koszyczkiem. Montażowy rym z upadkiem anioła, bez fizycznego związku lokacji. Poranek w lokalu zastępczym poza Domem Kultury. 1 s.

prompts.image: Use case: compositing. ONE photorealistic cinematic 16:9 tight insert of a WHITE sugar cube falling into BLACK coffee. Reference1 is mandatory exact Czeslaw drinking glass: tall clear straight-sided glass with delicate etched leaf motifs, ornate tarnished silver openwork METAL holder with loop handle and clear glass saucer. Preserve exact holder lattice, shape and proportions. Fill glass with black coffee to 2cm below rim. Reference2 locks scratched dark wooden desktop and morning light through left window blinds, tan folders and ordinary temporary office mood. High oblique camera about 60 degrees down, focus on black liquid surface and cube, glass in center, upper rim fully readable, lower holder visible. One small white sugar cube already released in midair just 1cm above center of coffee; no fingers or hand in crop. No splash yet. Small metal teaspoon lies on saucer. Quiet warm morning, shallow depth of field, cropped office folders far behind. This is a montage cut from a falling white angel to falling white sugar, not a physical connection between locations. No rubble, dust falling, tremor, damage, people, text or watermark.
prompts.animation: 3-second source, only first 1 second used. 0–0.25s: the single white sugar cube already above the coffee falls vertically into its center. 0.25–1s: cube sinks beneath the black surface, producing one small contained splash and concentric ripples. 1–3s: remaining ripples settle. Camera locked. Glass, etched pattern, metal holder, handle, saucer, teaspoon, folders and morning light remain fixed. No hand, second cube, floating sugar, oversized splash, moving desk, falling debris, new objects, morphing, cuts, captions or watermark.
